entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: Information element indicating the UE has uplink user data pending to be sent.

entities.name: UE has uplink user data pending
entities.description: Condition where the UE has uplink user data waiting to be transmitted.

entities.name: UE not performing periodic registration updating procedure
entities.description: Condition where the UE is not executing a periodic registration update procedure.

relations.description: The uplink data status IE is included when the UE has uplink user data pending.
The uplink data status IE is included unless the UE is performing a periodic registration updating procedure.
